purpose: Negative control for the boundary between slop density and functional correctness.

informed_by.title: Characterizing Overconfident Failure in LLM-Based Code Generation

density_expectation.rule: Do not lower the density score merely because the implementation fails its functional oracle.

functional_oracle.command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'plugins/ml-slop/skills/code/workspace/fixtures'); from dense_but_wrong import inclusive_sum; assert inclusive_sum(1, 3) == 6"
functional_oracle.expected_failure: range(start, end) excludes the documented inclusive endpoint.

report_expectation.required_scope_statement: The density score is not a functional-correctness, security, or authorship verdict.
